description: Set who sends the WhatsApp tasks of people in ONE campaign: their owner ("Responsável"), a member of the workspace. With owner, the people in prospectIds go to that member (owner null takes it off: nobody). With distributeAmong, the people in prospectIds, or without prospectIds everyone in the campaign with no owner yet, are dealt in turn among those members (round-robin, oldest first). Members are named by first name, full name, e-mail or user id; a name that matches nobody, or more than one member, answers with the workspace's members and changes nothing. Only the WhatsApp tasks follow the owner: e-mail and LinkedIn keep going from the campaign's sender. Free, and nothing is sent.

distributeAmong.description: Members to deal the people among, in turn (names, e-mails or user ids).

owner.description: The member who gets them (name, e-mail or user id), or null for nobody.

prospectIds.description: The people to change. Required with owner; with distributeAmong, omit to deal everyone in the campaign without an owner.

name: assign_prospects
title: Atribuir responsável
